notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that share a creature type.
description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and White Lotus Tile to become a creature.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and White Lotus Tile, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
